# Weekly sync, 2026-10-13

Attendees: [[Maya Okafor]], [[Tom Lindqvist]], [[Priya Raman]], [[Daniel Reyes]], [[Sofia Marchetti]], [[Kenji Watanabe]]

## Decisions
- SMS reminder provider: Sinch from 1 November 2026 (replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage]]). The Vonage rollout is superseded and the plan to discontinue Vonage stands.
- Onboarding rollout: concierge onboarding is live for all pilot clinics; onboarding rollout task is done. Replaces [[Decision - Onboarding flow is concierge onboarding call before account creation]].
- Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud (EU region); data stays in EU. Replaces [[Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted]].
- Release cadence: twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays, behind feature flags. Replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]].
- Investor updates cadence: monthly updates (keep metrics dashboard link). Replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link]].
- Design system: shadcn/ui. Replaces [[Decision - Design system is Tailwind UI kit]].

## Actions
- Priya Raman to design SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October 2026.
- Kenji Watanabe to cease Vonage rollout and ensure decommissioning of Vonage integrations by 1 November 2026.
- Maya Okafor to coordinate migration of product analytics to PostHog Cloud (EU region) and verify EU data residency.
- Tom Lindqvist to approve and monitor the new release cadence implementation (Tue/Thu behind feature flags).
- Explore options for per-practitioner calendar colours as a backlog item.

Decided on 2026-10-04 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

## Why
Weekly batches hid regressions.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Exports to CSV are used weekly by clinic managers for payroll. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second.
